title: GTA6 Reveals Massive Open World in 13 New Screenshots and Details
description: GTA6 gets a massive info drop! Push Square reports that a new Game Informer magazine issue reveals 13 new screenshots and details on Leonida's open world.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Reveals Massive, Dense Open World in 13 New Screenshots and Details

As the anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to build, new details regarding the game's expansive setting have surfaced. According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, a brand-new issue of Game Informer magazine has provided fresh insights into the world of Leonida, accompanied by a batch of 13 new screenshots.

### Exploring the Vast World of Leonida

Rockstar Games has shared more about the vibrant open world of Leonida that players will be able to explore when GTA 6 launches on 19th November 2026. Through the pages of the latest Game Informer magazine issue, fans are treated to a closer look at what makes this fictional rendition of Florida tick.

The newly detailed aspects of the open world include:

* **Diverse Regions**: A sprawling landscape featuring distinct areas waiting to be discovered.
* **Vibrant Wildlife**: A living, breathing natural ecosystem that enhances the immersion of the environment.
* **Engaging Activities**: A wide array of things to do across the map to keep players immersed in the world.

### A Visual Showcase

At the forefront of this new information drop are the 13 newly released screenshots. These images offer a stunning glimpse into the graphical fidelity, lighting, and meticulous attention to detail that Rockstar Games is pouring into GTA 6. From scenic vistas to bustling environments, the screenshots highlight the sheer scale and density of the Leonida region.

### Editor's Take

This latest magazine feature gives fans a welcome taste of what to expect in Leonida. With 13 new screenshots showcasing the world's density and regions, the November 19, 2026 release date can't come soon enough. Rockstar is clearly crafting an open world that will set a new benchmark for the industry.
